text.body: || śrīḥ || śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādapraṇītasarvamūlagranthāḥ sadācārasmṛtiḥ|| śrīmaddhanumadbhīmamadhvāntargatarāmakṛṣṇavedavyāsātmakaśrīlakṣmihayagrīvāya namaḥ || yasminsarvāṇi karmāṇi saṃnyasyādhyātmacetasā | nirāśīrnirmamo yāti paraṃ jayati so'cyutaḥ || 1 || smṛtvā viṣṇuṃ samutthāya kṛtaśauco yathāvidhi | dhautadantaḥ samācamya snānaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ || 2 || uddhṛteti mṛdālipya dviṣaḍaṣṭaṣaḍakṣaraiḥ | trirnimajyāpyasūktena prokṣayitvā punastataḥ || 3 || mṛdālipya nimajya tristrirjapedaghamarṣaṇam sraṣṭāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ param || 4 || yataśvāso nimagno'psu praṇavenotthitastataḥ | siñcayetpuruṣasūktena svadehasthaṃ hariṃ smaran || 5 || vasitvā vāsa ācamya prokṣyācamya ca mantrataḥ | gāyatryā cāñjaliṃ datvā dhyātvā sūryagataṃ harim || 6 || mantrataḥ parivṛtyātha samācamya surādikān | tarpayitvā nipīḍyātha vāso vistṛtya cāñjasā || 7 || arkamaṇḍalagaṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyātvaiva tripadīṃ japet | sahasraparamāṃ devīṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām || 8 || āsūryadarśanāttiṣṭhettatastūpaviśettu vā | pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ sanakṣatrāmuttarāṃ sadivākarām | uttarāmupaviśyaiva vāgyataḥ sarvadā japet || 9 || dhyeyaḥ sadā savitṛmaṇḍalamadhyavartī nārāyaṇaḥ sarasijāsanasanniviṣṭaḥ | keyūravānmakarakuṇḍalavānkirīṭī hārī hiraṇmayavapurdhṛtaśaṅkhacakraḥ || 10 || gāyatryāstriguṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyāyannaṣṭākṣaraṃ japet | praṇamya devānviprāṃśca gurūṃśca haripārṣadān || 11 || evaṃ sarvottamaṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyāyannevārcayeddharim | dhyānapravacanābhyāṃ ca yathāyogyamupāsanam || 12 || dharmeṇejyāsādhanāni sādhayitvā vidhānataḥ | snātvā sampūjayedviṣṇuṃ vedatantroktamārgataḥ | vaiśvadevaṃ baliṃ caiva kuryānnityaṃ tu tarpaṇam || 13 || iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ pūrtaṃ yaccātmanaḥ priyam | dārānsutānpriyānprāṇān parasmai sananivedayen || 14 || bhuktaśeṣaṃ bhagavato bhṛtyātithipurassaraḥ | bhiñjīta hṛdgataṃ viṣṇuṃ smaraṃstadgatamānasaḥ || 15 || ācamya mūlamantreṇa koṣṭhaṃ svamabhimantrayet | vedaśāstravinodena prīṇayanpuruṣottamam || 16 || ahaḥ śeṣaṃ nayetsandhyāmupāsītātha pūrvavat | yāmātparata evātha svapeddhyāyañjanārdanam | antarāle tato buddhvā smareta bahuśo harim || 17 || kāyena vācā manasendriyairvā buddhyātmanā vā prakṛtisvabhāvāt | karoti yadyatsakalaṃ parasmai nārāyaṇāyeti samarpayettat || 18 || `dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca | kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate || 19 || uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ | yo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ || 20 || yasmātkṣaramatīto'hamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ | ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 21 || yo māmevamasammūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam | sa sarvavidbhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata || 22 || iti guhyatamaṃ śāstramidamuktaṃ mayānagha | etadbuddhvā buddhimānsyātkṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata' || 23 || `rudraṃ samāśritā devā rudro brahmāṇamāśritaḥ | brahmā māmāśrito nityaṃ nāhaṃ kañcidupāśritaḥ' || 24 || `ye me matamidaṃ nityamanutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ | śraddhāvanto'nasūyanto mucyante te'pi karmabhiḥ || 25 || ye tvetadabhyasūyanto nānutiṣṭhanti me matam | sarvajñānavimūḍhāstānviddhi naṣṭānacetasaḥ' || 26 || `dvau bhūtasargau loke'smindaiva āsura eva ca | viṣṇubhaktiparo daivo viparītastathā''suraḥ' || 27 || `smartavyaḥ satataṃ viṣṇurvismartavyo na jātucit | sarve vidhiniṣedhāḥ syuretayoreva kiṅkarāḥ' || 28 || `dharmo bhavatyadharmo'pi kṛto bhaktaistavācyuta | pāpaṃ bhavati dharmo'pi yo na bhaktaiḥ kṛto hareḥ' || 29 || `manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru | nityaṃ bhavecca manniṣṭho bubhūṣuḥ puruśassadā' || 30 || eṣa nityaḥ sadācāro gṛhiṇo vaninastathā | vaiśvadevaṃ baliṃ dantadhāvanaṃ cāpyṛte vaṭoḥ || 31 || evameva yateḥ svīyavittena tu vinā sadā | mūlamantraiḥ sadā snānaṃ viṣṇoreva ca tarpaṇam || 32 || viśeṣo niṣkriyayaterajalāñjalitā tathā | tarpaṇaṃ tu harereva yateranyatra coditam || 33 || samiddhomo baṭoścaiva smṛtvā viṣṇuṃ hutāśane | sarvavarṇāśramairviṣṇureka evejyate sadā | ramābrahmādayastasya parivārata eva tu || 34 || `kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāramaṇoraṇīyāṃsamanusmaredyaḥ | sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt' || 35 || `vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntaṃ ādityavarṇaṃ tamasastu pāre | sarvāṇi rūpāṇi vicintya dhīraḥ nāmāni kṛtvābhivadanyadāste || 36|| dhātā purastādyamudājahāra śakraḥ pravidvānpradiśaścatasraḥ | tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate' || 37 || ānandatīrthamuninā vyāsavākyasamuddhṛtiḥ | sadācārasya viṣaye kṛtā saṅkṣepataḥ śubhā || 38 || aśeṣakalyāṇaguṇanityānubhavasattanuḥ | aśeṣadoṣarahitaḥ prīyatāṃ puruṣottamaḥ || 39 || || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitaḥ sadācārasmṛtiḥ samāptā || || iti sadācārasmṛtiḥ || || śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
